VTS Scoring Log

Protide Health

US-based vendor· Scored August 2026· protidehealth.com

Protide Health is a US-based research peptide vendor that sends every batch to Freedom Diagnostics, a named independent US analytical laboratory, before release. Testing covers LC-MS identity confirmation, HPLC-UV purity, and LAL endotoxin. Lot numbers on vials match batch-specific COAs. The COA library requires an account login to search and retrieve results - placing it in the login-gated accessibility tier rather than the open public database tier - which is the primary gap in an otherwise strong documentation setup.

Scoring Notes
Freedom Diagnostics named on every COA
Protide Health names Freedom Diagnostics as its third-party testing partner consistently across the site - on the About page, FAQs, and within the COA documents themselves. This is a verifiable claim: a buyer can ask which lab and receive a specific, consistent answer. It is more meaningful than unnamed 'independent laboratory' language.
COA library is login-gated - requires account registration
The COA library landing page is publicly visible, but retrieving actual COA documents requires creating an account. Per VTS methodology, login-gated access scores the same as email-on-request: below the open public database standard. This is the largest single gap in the score. An outsider cannot verify COA content without registering, which adds friction and reduces independent verifiability. Additionally, COAs resolve to Protide's own domain rather than Freedom Diagnostics' own server, so even registered users cannot cross-check directly against the lab's own database.
Newer operation - track record will improve over time
Available evidence points to operations beginning in 2025. The documentation architecture is fully developed, but the operational history is shorter than established peers. The track record score reflects this gap and is expected to increase as operations continue.
Credit card accepted (Visa, Amex, Discover)
Credit card processing is confirmed. Mastercard is not currently accepted. Payment processor vetting is a baseline legitimacy signal relative to crypto-only vendors.
